correctness.rationale: For an unrestricted partition, independently choose the odd-part subpartition of total a=(n+d)/2 and the halved even-part partition of total t=(n-d)/4. This is an exact bijection N_n(d)=Q(a)p(t) when both are nonnegative integers and zero otherwise; hence d=n (mod 4). Applying classical p(t) and Q(a) asymptotics uniformly on fixed |d|<=K n^{3/4} yields the exponent -pi d^2/(4 sqrt(6) n^{3/2}) and prefactor 2/(6^{1/4} n^{3/4}); Taylor remainder O_K(n^{-1/2}), prefactor relative error O_K(n^{-1/4}). Lattice spacing four and tightness yield CLT with variance 2 sqrt(6)/pi. For 4|n, exact balance Q(n/2)p(n/4) and its asymptotic follow. Independently enumerated all partitions for n=0..17 and confirmed the bijection; finite cases do not prove asymptotics.
